_comment: The open-source software Whiz.app carries, and the models it downloads.
build.py turns this, the Python packages actually installed in the
engine, and Sparkle's own LICENSE into Contents/Resources/Acknowledgements.json,
which Whiz shows under Whiz > Acknowledgements.
'files' are relative to this directory; '@name' is a file the build passes
in (--file name=PATH). 'version' is a literal or '@name' for one the build
reads from the component itself, so a version shown is the version shipped.
'python_packages' stands for every package installed in the engine.
'expect' fails the build when a component changes under a licence text
copied for one version: refresh the text, then the expectation.
archive of the release build-engine.sh pins), cut to what is linked into
the bundled libpython: ncurses, libedit and zlib are macOS's own, Tcl/Tk
is trimmed. Bumping PYTHON_VERSION means re-checking this list.
